descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_1_pass: +3%% ranged attack speed per stack, up to 15%%. Lasts 4s; hits refresh it.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass: Empower your next normal arrow to deal 125%% damage. Lasts 5s; ranged haste is reduced by 25%% until fired.
Block the next 3 eligible physical attacks within 10s.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas: +2%% melee damage and damage reduction per stack, up to 5 stacks. Lasts 8s; hits refresh it.
Gain 1 armor plus 6%% melee power and 1 maximum heart per stack, up to 10 stacks. Lasts 8s; hits refresh it. New hearts are healed; refreshing at maximum stacks does not heal.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_pas: Ready 5 melee hits for 6s. Each grants +2%% attack and movement speed, up to 10%% each, for 3s. Hits refresh the buffs.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas: Gain +4%% melee damage and +8%% size at each health threshold, up to +24%% damage and +48%% size. Bonuses adjust as your health changes.
Gain 6 HP plus 30%% melee power as absorption for 12s. Stun enemies within 5 blocks for 2s.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_1_passi: Reduce armor by 2 plus 10%% melee power per stack, up to 3 stacks. Lasts 6s; further applications refresh it.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi: +20%% evasion for 2s. Taking damage does not end the buff.
Your next melee hit is a guaranteed critical with +20%% critical damage. Use within 5s.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi: Survive a fatal hit with 3s damage immunity, Speed III and Jump Boost III. Gain +30%% evasion for 6s.
Counter the attacker for 25%% dual-wield melee damage.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass: Explode for up to 40%% Arcane damage within 5 blocks, excluding the struck enemy. Damage decreases with distance.
Restore health equal to 10%% Arcane power.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_pass: Leave a trap for 5s. Deals 40%% Arcane damage and applies Weakness II for 6s within 1.5 blocks.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass: Ready your next Arcane spell for 5s. Its hits make enemies take 20%% more Arcane damage for 6s.
Gain an absorption shield for 8s: 1 heart plus 1 heart per 5 Arcane power.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_1_passiv: Enemies take +4%% Fire damage per stack, up to 20%%. Lasts 2s; further applications refresh it.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_passiv: Leave a trap for 5s. Deals 30%% Fire damage and burns enemies for 4s within 1.5 blocks.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv: Explode for up to 30%% Fire damage within 5 blocks. Damage decreases with distance.
Gain an absorption shield for 8s: 1 heart plus 1 heart per 10 Fire power. Attackers take 30%% Fire damage.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_1_passi: Enemies take +8%% Frost critical damage per stack, up to 40%%. Lasts 2s; further applications refresh it.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi: Leave a trap for 5s. Freeze enemies within 1.5 blocks for 4s.
Your next Frost spell deals 20%% more damage. Use within 5s.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi: Reset Frost spell cooldowns, except Blizzard and Frost Elemental.
Gain an absorption shield for 8s: 1 heart plus 1 heart per 10 Frost power. Slows attackers.
descriptions.spell.rogues.charge.description: +50%% base movement speed and +25%% knockback resistance for 2s. Break free of movement impairments and prevent new ones for 2s. Usable while controlled.
descriptions.spell.rogues.shout.description: Weaken enemy melee, ranged and magic power by 8%% and reveal them for 6s. Break free of movement impairments and prevent new ones for 3s. Usable while controlled.
descriptions.spell.rogues.throw.description: Hurl your weapon for up to 80%% melee damage with slight homing. Slows enemies for 1s. Gain Weakness IV for 2s after release; the throw retains its original damage.
descriptions.spell.rogues.throw_net.description: Hurl a seeking net for up to 15%% melee damage. Root enemies for 2s and pull them in front of you. Powerful enemies can resist the root and pull.
descriptions.spell.rogues.last_stand.description: Each of 5 pulses grants 0.6s damage immunity and refreshes Regeneration I and knockback immunity for 15s. Remain stationary while channeling; stun or freeze interrupts it.
descriptions.spell.rogues.mortal_strike.description: Each of 5 pulses grants +15%% attack speed, +10%% basic-attack damage, +15%% knockback resistance and +20%% damage taken for 12s. The final pulse fully heals and grants Speed IV for 2s. Expiry fully heals. A fatal hit ends the buff and fully heals, but puts early skills on cooldown and causes Nausea for 10s and stun for 5s.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe: +4%% critical chance per Berserker pulse, up to 20%%. Lasts until Berserker ends.
Melee hits restore 1 heart during Berserker. Lose 1 HP every 0.5s, ignoring defenses.
+1%% melee damage per direct hit taken during Last Stand, up to 10%%. Refreshes the bonus and Regeneration I for 5s.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe: Throw Net also hits enemies within 5 blocks of impact. Each enemy's strength determines whether it can be rooted and pulled.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe: Your next melee hit after Wild Charge stuns for 2s. Use within 4s.
descriptions.spell.wizards.arcane_beam.description: Channel 25 hits, each dealing 20%% Arcane damage. Consumes all Arcane Charges. Charged Beam changes the channel and damage.
descriptions.spell.wizards.arcane_missile.description: Channel 12 homing missiles, each dealing 26%% Arcane damage.
descriptions.spell.wizards.fire_breath.description: Breathe fire in front of you for 13%% Fire damage per hit, with no distance falloff.
descriptions.spell.wizards.fire_meteor.description: Drop 3 meteors on the target. Each deals 150%% Fire damage within 6 blocks, with no distance falloff.
descriptions.spell.wizards.fire_wall.description: Place up to 4 walls within 5s. Each lasts 8s, deals 20%% Fire damage per hit and reaches 2 blocks high. The fourth wall or placement timeout starts the cooldown.
descriptions.spell.wizards.frost_blizzard.description: Rain frost shards on the target and nearby enemies. Each deals about 26.7%% Frost damage within 3 blocks and slows enemies. No distance falloff.
descriptions.spell.wizards.frost_shield.description: Block all incoming damage for 3s, with -100%% base movement speed. When the shield expires, freeze enemies within 5 blocks for 2s.
descriptions.spell.wizards.arcane_evocation.descripti: Channel up to 10 stacks lasting 10s. Each grants +5%% base spell critical chance, +3%% spell haste and +10%% damage taken.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel: Channel 50 hits. Damage grows from 10%% to 15%% Arcane power, gaining 0.15%% per hit. Beam width starts at 130%% and grows by 10%% per hit, up to 500%%.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel: Arcane Explosion deals 160%% Arcane damage. Hitting an enemy resets its cooldown.
descriptions.spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell: Ice Lance is 50%% larger and gains +15%% critical chance.
